label: SCG I.22 n.4 second case, dependence sense of per se necessity, n.2 coverage and n.6
summary: Follow-up of PR #1602 for #1608 (D to E on the God route, #1595, #319). Analyst reconstruction of SCG I.22 nn.2-6, attribution deferred (orientation witness la.wikisource oldid 132346; no chapter-specific corpus passage). Added the dependence sense of n.3's 'non per se necesse' as PER_SE_NECESSARY_2 (PerSeNecessaryEsseAt: exists and nothing other than e causes its necessity; DependentConjunctionAt: joined and the joining depends on something), sibling of the #1602 modal proxy PER_SE_NECESSARY_1 (NecessaryEsseAt / ContingentConjunctionAt), with a new disambiguation and no bridge asserted between the senses. New primitive relata, each defined in d421e2c9: conjunctionDependsOn, absolutelyDependsOn, necessityFrom, essenceDependsOn, perSeOne. OPEN premises: n.4's second written case (joined, not intelligible apart, joining depends on s implies e depends absolutely on s), n.2's per se clause (absolute dependence on another s gives necessity from s; kept as a premise, not folded into the definition), an analyst coarsening of n.2's dilemma and trilemma as coverage for joined distinct principles (weaker in disjuncts, broader in domain than n.2, which speaks only of the per se necessary esse; likewise the second-case premise; the encoded n.2 clause is stronger than the text, assigning necessity from another to every absolutely dependent esse; PerSeNecessaryEsseAt encodes existence and the per se component only, no necessity proper; scope notes after semantic challenge F2-F3), n.2 horn (iii)'s accident principle, and n.6's union causation with per se unity primitive. Results (Lean, Comparator, NanoDa and bind-check pass locally): (1) control (a) in general form: an inseparable union of a per se necessary esse with distinct q cannot depend on q; (2) both n.4 cases in the dependence sense, by a constructive case split on intelligibility apart, without #1602's modal-to-intelligibility bridge: a quiddity whose joining has a source other than the esse is not the esse-identified bearer's quiddity; (3) with coverage and horn (iii): no represented-distinct joined proposed quiddity is that bearer's quiddity; (4) with n.6 instead of coverage: a genuine non-unified quiddity has a joining source not other than the esse (some s with not s distinct from e; 'only' follows from result (2) under the same premises, not from this type). Seven finite controls on #1602's stable distinct profile: n.3's own q-dependent union is dependent but not modally contingent (the modal proxy misses it) and satisfies every premise except the second case; omissions for the per se clause, horn (iii) accident principle and per se unity; a positive separable profile. Answer to the brief's question: the #1602 stable distinct profile survives the full encoded n.3-4 bundle (both cases, dependence sense) only with an unsourced (co-fundamental) or self-sourced joining; with n.3's q-dependent joining it is refuted through the second case and n.2 horn (i). The co-fundamental profile (unsourced, one per se) and the self-sourced profile satisfy every encoded premise except the coarsened n.2 coverage.
blocker: Strongest standing rival: a co-fundamental union, distinct esse and quiddity that are one per se with no source of their joining. Its exact price in this encoding is the denial of the coarsened n.2 coverage (a consonant union of distinct principles with no dependence in any direction) together with the claim that distinct principles are one per se, which conflicts with n.6's unencoded main premise (omne autem quod convenit alicui quod non est de essentia eius, convenit ei per aliquam causam) and its implicit step from 'non est de essentia eius' to 'per se non sunt unum'; divine simplicity in n.6 yields only that esse is not a part of the essence but praeter essentiam (CORRECTION after the semantic challenge on #1618, F1: an earlier draft placed the conflict in simplicity); neither denial is refuted here and no positive replacement account of such per se unity is in the corpus. The self-sourced residual (joining depends only on the esse) also survives without coverage; n.6's self-causation clause is not encoded. JoinedDistinctQuiddityRejectedAt rejects only the proposed quiddity, so reaching essenceOf = esseOf further needs the proposed quiddity to range over the actual q.3 essence. Next tests: (i) encode n.6's main premise (what belongs to a thing but is not of its essence belongs to it through a cause) and the step from non de essentia to non per se unum, and test both on the co-fundamental profile, where simplicity supplies only praeter essentiam; (ii) formalize n.6's self-causation clause against the self-sourced profile; (iii) state the bridge from rejecting every distinct proposed quiddity to essenceOf = esseOf and connect to ActualUnderivedEssenceEsse; (iv) investigate warrant for coverage as an independent premise.
